notes: Objective posted as the section header 'ObjectiveWYS/TPCGALR' (Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough); it counts toward the 60, which makes the total 60.

Cards marked '(start)' in the list: Tatooine, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Tatooine: Cantina, Insurrection, Staging Areas, Squadron Assignments and Heading For The Medical Frigate; all count toward the 60. Three Effects are marked as starting, so no single starting Effect is set.
Posted 'Wedgie' dested Wedge Antilles (strategy: 'Wedge deploys for cheap and can be replaced by RSL'); 'Wedge Antilles, RSL' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader.
Posted 'Roller Skate' dested Pulsar Skate (Mirax Terrik's ship; Mirax is in the deck).
Posted '(generic) Docking Bay x2' dested Spaceport Docking Bay; 'T; DB 94' and 'T Cantina' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 and Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine' dested the Light Premiere system.

Posted 'ECC Lando', 'ECC Chewie', 'EPP Luke', 'EPP Han' and 'LS,JK' dested Lando With Blaster Pistol, Chewie With Blaster Rifle, Luke With Lightsaber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight (strategy confirms Jedi Knight). 'Rayc Ryjard' dested Rayc Ryjerd; 'YISYW' dested Your Insight Serves You Well; 'Suadron Assignments' dested Squadron Assignments.
Strategy says the 4th Fallen Portal should be an Underworld Contacts; the list as posted (4 Fallen Portal) is kept.
